warnings: Intensity significance is derived using I≈F² and σ(I)≈2|F|σ(F), a first-order approximation unreliable near zero; F/σ(F) remains available in the sample table.
methods: Distinct input HKL orbits intersected with theoretical symmetry-allowed orbits, divided by all allowed orbits from infinite d to the input d_min; 000 and systematic absences excluded. Friedel pairs are combined by the existing coverage convention; this does not merge or modify input values. The d_min boundary is inclusive with relative reciprocal tolerance 1e-12 (at least 8 floating-point ULPs).

d98 is the highest-resolution theoretical boundary at which cumulative allowed-HKL coverage from sin(theta)/lambda = 0 reaches at least 98%. It need not stay above 98% at every preceding boundary, depends on the input d_min domain, and is not an independent experimental quality cutoff.
Statistics use finite non-000 original per-record values. FWHM units: input units.
Presence of duplicates does not prove unmerged observations. Current text input merging/scaling provenance is unknown.
